saySample.text: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 20s telling A woman, maybe 40s, with freckles about A person, maybe 50s. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
🧭 A person, maybe 50s is back from the west. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with freckles returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 30s returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with a slouched posture returns with water: +2 clean.
"Hey." A man, maybe 40s settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 40s.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A woman, maybe 60s came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)
A woman, maybe 30s, with grey-streaked hair: "a fountain of sharp-edged grass smelling of lemon is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
A woman, maybe 40s, with freckles came back with 538 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Elena and Willow lingered over the fire together.
Aisha and Willow lingered over the fire together.
Gonzalo and Willow lingered over the fire together.
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
🔥 “I don’t say this lightly.” Maya sets their bowl down. “Elena, your trade story isn’t true, is it? I’ve heard enough versions now.” Nobody looks at Elena. Everybody does.
A woman, maybe 40s, with freckles will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A person, maybe 50s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A woman, maybe 30s, with grey-streaked hair watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
📋 A woman, maybe 40s, with freckles — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 60s speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Gonzalo," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Gonzalo." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Gonzalo).
"Willow," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Willow." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Willow).
"Maya," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Maya." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Maya).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
It's barely dawn. The day is yours — sleep is for later.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
A woman, maybe 60s shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)

🌿 Willow checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~5 days of fresh on hand… leaves the fish nets standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 Willow hauls back 4 wood. The pile grows. (14 logs now.)
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with freckles returns with 9L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s, with a slouched posture telling A woman, maybe 30s, with weathered hands about Willow. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
A woman, maybe 60s heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
Gonzalo heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
🚶 Maya is back — found A woman, maybe 40s, with freckles.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
